[EN] Kill {@Creature:47#4001#argonomorph Dagonite crusaders}, {@Creature:47#4002#argonomorph naga wyrmlings}, and {@Creature:47#4003#argonomorph gula smashers} on the {@Rgn:47005$$Argon Frontier} and collect tokens.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Laetesha at Pathfinder Post when mission is complete.
